method: Hedonic ridge regression on log(price per m²) with district, size, floor, building age, near-rail and price-index features; split-conformal 80% range.
split: train before 2025-07; calibrate 2025-07 to 2025-12; test from 2026-01

dataset.name: U-Estate synthetic condo sales (demo)
sources: Synthetic district base prices (SYNTHETIC_DISTRICT_BASE in src/lib/valuation/dataset.ts)
SAMPLE condo price index (src/data/index-sample.ts), standing in for the Bank of Thailand index

index.label: SAMPLE index (replace with Bank of Thailand Residential Property Price Index)

notice: Trained and tested on synthetic demo data generated from synthetic district prices and a SAMPLE price index; it shows the method works, not market accuracy.
limitations: Condos only; other property types show 'Not enough data'.
Only the districts in the training data; others show 'Not enough data'.
